args.body:
File: docs/API.md

Document the field limits for reports:
- `name` has a maximum length of 120 characters.
- `categories` can contain up to 50 items (each up to 60 characters).
- `schedule.recipients` can contain between 1 and 20 email addresses.
args.title: Document field limits for reports in the API reference
